draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the time on our onboarding call last week, and I'm glad Tariq got your VAT question sorted -- a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings, and that ticket is closed on our side.

When you're ready to get going, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and if it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week to get your first one set up with you.

Best,
Priya
